scope: curated live subset available in the release package, not the full development run

checks.name: configuration agrees with the module defaults
every configured end marker seen in the captures is Unicode
the HTML-style marker never appears in real output
all complete replies parse to one object
truncated replies are classified as truncation, not invalid JSON
extracted reaction always comes from the post-reasoning segment
reaction present in every parsed object
a rule identifier is present in every parsed object
decisive_event_ids present in every parsed object
every call got its own server-assigned conversation id, none reused
no capture carries accumulated multi-turn history
finish_reason is populated on every capture
output stayed under the frozen 4096-token ceiling on complete replies
